gnbEntry.title: Where would you like to start?
gnbEntry.subtitle: Build meals for today, or set up a training nutrition schedule that adjusts your macros based on your workout type.
gnbEntry.continueDesc: Build meals using your standard macro targets.
gnbEntry.trainDesc: Set up a weekly training schedule and your macro targets will automatically adjust on training days versus rest days.
gnbEntry.scheduleDesc: Set your weekly training type and get macro targets tailored to each day.
gnbEntry.explainer: Your macro targets stay the same every day until you set up a training schedule. Once active, training days get more carbohydrates and rest days pull back — automatically.
